source: ESPN NBA game summaries (box score + play-by-play)

method.r: Pearson on raw per-game stats over games both played
method.phi: Pearson on Over/Under hits at proxy lines (floor(season mean) + 0.5)
method.shrunk: phi shrunk in Fisher-z toward the league mean for the stat pair and role pairing
method.r_close: r over games decided by 12 or fewer
